goal.outcome: Produce a defensible research brief while improving joint capability.
goal.done_when: All claims pass checks and the human approves publication.
goal.failure_cost: A bad draft is reversible; an erroneous publication is consequential.

topology.simpler_baseline: one model call plus citation checks
topology.why_more_structure_is_needed: Long-horizon work needs checkpoints and a separate publication boundary.

decisions.scope: Research, write, and locally revise the brief.

capability_basis.human_evidence: The user supplied the research objective.
capability_basis.system_evidence: Prior citation audits passed on this task family.
capability_basis.joint_evidence: Prior drafts were accepted after deterministic checks.

decisions.system_may_act_when: Checks are available and no publication action is attempted.
decisions.human_required_when: A taste choice materially changes the thesis.

decisions.scope: Release the brief outside the workspace.

capability_basis.human_evidence: The user owns audience and reputational judgement.
capability_basis.system_evidence: The system can report checks but has no publication authority.

signals.criterion: No unsupported material claim and all requirements pass.
signals.measurement_error: Semantic defects may escape deterministic checks.

signals.observation: A prospective acceptance prediction and the later user verdict.
signals.criterion: Prediction error against the explicit verdict.
signals.measurement_error: Silence is not an acceptance label.

signals.observation: Prospective predictions and independently checked outcomes by decision family.
signals.criterion: Calibration and failure rate within the declared task family.

signals.observation: Revisions, accepted recommendations, and adjudicated outcomes.
signals.criterion: Direction of outcome change after human intervention.
signals.measurement_error: A revision does not prove improvement.

signals.observation: Task outcome, interaction cost, and capability change under the compiled division of work.
signals.criterion: Better outcome or lower burden than the matched baseline without more unsafe autonomy.
signals.measurement_error: One run cannot separate complementarity from task luck.

actions.description: Revise the private draft and rerun checks.
Present the recommendation and request an explicit decision.

rules.when: A named defect remains and revision budget is available.
The checked draft is ready for external release.
rules.authority_limit: The system recommends; the human decides and acts.

steps.operation: Run independent outcome and capability checks.
Select a declared action under the authority policy.
steps.input: Signals, decision boundaries, and remaining budget.

verification.subject: Every material factual claim.
verification.method: Resolve citations and compare each claim with source evidence.
verification.on_fail: Return named defects to the revision loop.

verification.subject: The external publication decision.
verification.method: Present the recommendation, uncertainty, and alternatives.

capability_learning.prediction_receipt: Record prospective probabilities before observing outcomes.
capability_learning.promotion_gate: Promote only from repeated prospective predictions with measured error in a bounded task family.
capability_learning.demotion_gate: Demote on drift, failed verification, or calibration outside tolerance.

prospective_value.forecast_lock: Record human and system forecasts independently before either sees the other forecast or the outcome.
prospective_value.action_value_rule: Estimate expected declared outcome utility for each allowed action, then subtract cost and risk and add declared learning value.
prospective_value.value_of_information_rule: Seek evidence only when its expected change in the best allowed action value exceeds measurement and delay cost.
prospective_value.combination_rule: Do not fuse human and system forecasts without task-local calibration and dependence evidence; otherwise surface their range and disagreement.
prospective_value.dependence_rule: Treat shared context, model family, data, or disclosure as correlated evidence.
prospective_value.measurement_disturbance_rule: Record whether asking, testing, explaining, or verifying changes human attention, confidence, the source, evaluator, task state, or future evidence.
prospective_value.future_observation_value_rule: Price how the current action changes the quality and availability of later observations, not only immediate information gain.
prospective_value.counterfactual_rule: Label disturbance or action effects causal only with randomisation, paired twins, a defensible causal model, or explicit partial-identification bounds.
prospective_value.conservative_budget_rule: Apply disturbance and authority caps to a declared upper uncertainty bound, not only a point estimate.
prospective_value.fixed_weak_baseline: Compare adaptive control with the simplest low-disturbance fixed policy under matched budgets.
prospective_value.negative_control: Include a setting where the measurement cannot disturb the source and reject a built-in policy advantage there.
prospective_value.uncalibrated_behavior: Label estimates uncalibrated and keep them in shadow mode.
prospective_value.low_ceiling_behavior: Surface that every route has low predicted value; do not turn a relative winner into an absolute quality claim.
hard_constraints: Safety and authority constraints are applied before value optimisation.
leakage_guards: No feature computed from the outcome or future trace may drive prospective control.
Lock forecasts before disclosing another controller's forecast.
prospective_value.promotion_gate: Promote only when the value-aware policy improves objective outcomes against a matched baseline without more unsafe autonomy.

continuity.checkpoint: Persist the draft, evidence ledger, predictions, and open decisions after each cycle.
continuity.state_validity: Valid only while sources, task scope, and authority remain unchanged.
continuity.drift_check: Recheck source freshness and calibration scope at resume.
continuity.reset_when: Reset capability claims when the task family or outcome criterion changes.
continuity.resume_from: The last verified checkpoint, never an unverified partial action.
continuity.interrupt_only_when: A declared boundary is crossed or consequential ambiguity was not anticipated.
continuity.recover_without_interrupt_when: A bounded recovery action can restore independent verification.
continuity.interrupt_when_recovery_fails: The recovery budget is exhausted or the remaining choice crosses a human authority boundary.

available_actions.effect: Select the recommended route under its declared authority and verification boundary.
available_actions.evidence_effect: Records uptake; later outcome evidence must judge quality.

available_actions.effect: Select a surfaced alternative and its declared trade-off.
Ask the system to gather or expose one named missing observation.
available_actions.evidence_effect: Adds evidence without labelling the outcome.

available_actions.effect: Change what counts as success and invalidate routes tied to the old criterion.
available_actions.evidence_effect: Changes the target; prior scores require re-interpretation.

available_actions.effect: Tighten or relax the standing authority boundary at the next safe transition.
available_actions.evidence_effect: Changes policy scope, not measured capability.

available_actions.effect: Give the system temporary authority with an explicit budget and verifier.
available_actions.evidence_effect: Creates a prospective test of system capability.

available_actions.effect: Stop the affected action while preserving the task and checkpoint.
End the whole goal and record why recovery or reframing is not worthwhile.
available_actions.evidence_effect: Records a control choice, not objective failure.

human_controller.choice_interpretation: A human choice is a control action, not proof of objective quality.
human_controller.framing_guard: Present consequences and uncertainty without hiding, preselecting, or falsely equalising alternatives.
human_controller.human_measurement_rule: Treat every human observation as a scoped signal with a construct, criterion, error, confounds, and maturity.
calibration_path: Name the construct and criterion before deciding.
Record a prospective prediction and confidence before the outcome.
Observe an independent objective outcome where one is available.
Score error across repeated cases in the same task family.
Retain capability only inside the evidenced scope.
Demote or reset on task, criterion, or environment drift.

evaluation.matched_baseline: One model call plus citation checks.
